Key observations from the test image:
- Leaves show a whitish/silvery powdery coating on upper surfaces
- Multiple leaves affected across the plant
- Leaves appear somewhat dark green with the white coating distributed in patches
- Leaf texture looks slightly wrinkled/puckered

Top candidates: **Powdery_Mildew** (white powdery coating on leaves), **Downy_mildew** (pale spots on upper surface), **Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus** (mottling/wrinkling).

Let me view reference images for my top candidates.
The Powdery Mildew reference shows very similar silvery/white coating on leaves that matches the test image well. Let me check a few more candidates to be thorough.

Bean_Pod_Mottle top-left has some resemblance but shows more mottling/beetle feeding. Soybean_Dwarf_Mosaic shows much more yellowing and curling — doesn't match. Let me view 2 more to complete my 6 minimum.

Frogeye shows distinct gray/brown spots — not matching. Septoria shows dark brown spots with yellowing — not matching.

**Initial prediction: Powdery_Mildew** — the whitish/silvery powdery coating uniformly covering multiple leaf surfaces is the hallmark symptom.

Now reading the Attractor Guide.

Powdery_Mildew is listed as over-predicted (3x), with Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus (2x) and Soybean_Cyst_Nematode (1x) being the actual classes. I already viewed the Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus reference — it showed plants with silvery/mottled appearance plus beetle feeding and pod discoloration. The test image lacks the green/yellow mottling pattern and shows a more uniform whitish powdery coating across leaf surfaces.

**Key distinguishing evidence:**
- Test image: uniform whitish/silvery powdery coating covering large portions of dark green leaf surfaces — matches Powdery Mildew exactly
- Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus: would show green-to-yellow blotchy mottling, puckering, distortion — not present
- Soybean_Cyst_Nematode: would show yellowing/stunting with root symptoms — no visible yellowing or stunting here
- The Powdery Mildew reference (top-right, bottom-right panels) matches the test image very closely with the grayish-white coating over dark green leaves

Confidence in Powdery_Mildew remains high.

No yellow/green mottling (Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus), no discrete spots (Frogeye/Septoria), no yellowing or stunting (Soybean_Cyst_Nematode). Checked attractor guide; Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus is the main alternative but lacks the characteristic mottling pattern present in its reference images."}
